headline: ProPakistani says DeepSeek's V4.1 AI model is currently priced about 1,500 times below its usual rate.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: headline only, the 1,500-times figure could not be checked and no other outlet carries it.
importance_line: If correct, developers and companies using DeepSeek's model could run it at a tiny fraction of the usual cost, but the price, the exact version and how long the offer lasts are not known, and no other outlet has confirmed the figure.
summary: ProPakistani reports that DeepSeek, the Chinese AI company, is currently pricing its V4.1 model about 1,500 times below its usual rate.
notes: Headline only: propakistani.pk returned 403 and no other outlet carries the 1,500-times claim. Related coverage (Benin Web TV, 9 Oct 2026) reports that DeepSeek launched V4.1 Flash with lower API prices, but gives no 1,500-times figure; not used in the entry.
